 Order

The petitioners' land bearing Sy.No.217/B/2/2 measuring 2 acres situated at Kundaragi Village of Bilagi Taluk was proposed to be acquired for the purpose of upper Krishna project by issuing a notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, (for short, hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 1894') dated 31.12.2013 and published on 07.01.2019 which culminated in issuing final notification on 25.06.2015.
Being aggrieved, this petition is filed.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that when the preliminary notification under Section 4(1) of the Act, 1894 was issued, by that time, the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, hereinafter referred to as,
'the Act, 2013') came into force with effect from 01.01.2014.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Therefore, the Act, 1984 having been repealed on the date when the preliminary notification was published in the official gazette, the preliminary notification and the final notification issued are one without authority of law.

3. Per contra, learned AGA submits that Section 114 of the Act, 2013, deals with the repeal and savings and the repeal shall not prejudice or affect the general application of Section 6 of the General Clauses Act.
Therefore, Section 4(1) notification having been issued prior to the commencement of 2013 Act, the impugned notification can be said to be unenforceable.
4. The term notification is not defined under the Act, 1894.
Therefore, the provisions of the Karnataka General NC: 2024:KHC-D:3848 Clauses Act, 1899 have to be resorted to.
Section 3 sub Section (24b) of the Karnataka General Clauses Act, 1899 defines the term notification, and means a notification published in the official gazette.

The preliminary notification issued under Section 4(1)
of the Act was published on 07.01.2014 i.e., after commencement of the Act, 2013.

Therefore, the Act, 1894 having been repealed, the preliminary notification dated 30.12.2013 issued under Section 4(1) of the Act, 1894, as well as the final notification under Section 6 of the Act, 2013 read with Section 17 of the Act, 1894, are without authority of law and are not enforceable.
Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The impugned preliminary notification dated 31.12.2013 issued by the respondent No.1 at Annexure - C as well as the final notification dated 25.06.2015 issued by the respondent No.2, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
